zh.text: 外壳从 Electron 换成 Tauri 2（Rust + 系统 WebView2），不再随包分发 Chromium 与 Node 运行时
界面用 React + shadcn/ui 重做：主控台、服务器日志、账号管理、指令手册、数据库、模组市场、配置中心、设置
新增 three.js 启动动画，取不到 WebGL 时静默退回 CSS 层
服务卡片补齐 PID / CPU / 内存 / 运行时长读数；实时日志按服务分 tab 且切换页面不丢
环境自检扩到八项：Node.js、Rust/Cargo、VS++ 构建工具、服务端依赖、本地数据库、市场服务二进制、客户端路径、客户端证书 CA
修复 0.12.9 环境拉不到模组市场清单的问题（清单改走 EVEjs-mods 的 Pages 与 jsDelivr 双源）
模组发布改为「本地签名 + GitHub 令牌」流程；换到新框架时自动接管老启动器的作者身份 key 与令牌，无需重填
体积大幅下降：便携版主程序 exe 约 9.2 MB（现役 Electron 便携版约 73 MB；体积门禁 exe ≤ 12 MB）
修复服务卡片的读数：图片服务与网关代理没有独立进程，之前读数永远是「—」，现在跟随主服务器显示 PID / CPU / 内存 / 运行时长；两者的启停状态仍只认各自的端口探针，不会因为主服务器在跑就跟着变绿
修复新建模组即使勾了「建好后立即启用」也仍然生成 loader.js.disabled：界面把选项传成了内部键名（enableAfterCreate / signAfterCreate），后端读的却是 enabled / sign，导致勾选无效；现在勾选即生成可加载的 loader.js，并且新建模组默认就是启用状态
修复发布过一次的模组在「发布模组」里再也选不中：旧逻辑把「审核中」的模组从候选里剔除，而新版发布只是往自己的仓库推一版 + 发 Release，收录源一辈子只登记一次，任何审核状态都不该挡住发新版；候选池现在只按「是我创建的」过滤，另外把本地 .evejs-source.json 也算作「已有源码仓库」的凭据，避免换过数据目录后又重复建仓
「编辑信息」现在真的能保存：新增 mods:updateMeta 写通道，只改显示名 / 简介 / 分类 / 标签 / 冲突 / 重启语义与 README（id、version、author、签名一律不碰），保存后自动重新签名，签名失败整份回滚；不是本人的模组会被拒绝
新增单文件便携版：双击一个约 9.2 MB 的 EvEJSLauncher.exe 就能运行，不解压、不安装；启动器缓存（data / cache / cli / updater / mods / temp）仍然放在 exe 同级的 _launcher 目录，随包的 Node CLI 与自更新器会在首次启动时释放到位（内容一致则跳过，被改坏的文件会自动修复）
修复模组市场的「导入 ZIP」是假提示：按下去只弹一句「已选择模组包…」，既不弹系统文件选择框也不落盘；现在真的走系统「打开文件」选 ZIP，导入后重扫模组列表并提示落地目录（取消不报错，来源未收录会单独提醒）。旁边的「打开 mods 目录」也从假提示接成真动作，目录不存在会先建出来
修复「服务端已经部署好、模组页却一直报服务端根目录不对」：渲染层以前还拿配置文件里的路径跟一个写死的旧目录（E:\Games\EveJS-v0.12.8）比对，换到 0.12.9 就必然误报；现在只信后端扫描器给出的结论，并把那条提示改成它真正想说的话——目录下缺 mods/ 文件夹，且直接给一个「自动创建 mods/」按钮，不再让用户自己去翻目录
自更新弹窗的更新说明改为读真清单（update-manifest.json 的 changelog），不再显示原型里的示例条目；分组与配色沿用原型排版，中英两版说明都能渲染
修复「发布模组 → 提交审核」的完成提示说反了：首次发布明明往索引仓库提交了收录源 PR，却因为写完台账再取状态而提示「没有 PR」；现在会把真实结果与那条 PR 的地址一并显示出来

en.text: Shell rewritten from Electron to Tauri 2 (Rust + system WebView2); no bundled Chromium or Node runtime
Interface rebuilt with React + shadcn/ui: dashboard, server logs, accounts, command manual, database, mod marketplace, config center, settings
New three.js boot animation with a silent CSS fallback when WebGL is unavailable
Service cards now report PID / CPU / memory / uptime; live logs are tabbed per service and survive page switches
Environment self-check expanded to eight items: Node.js, Rust/Cargo, VS++ Build Tools, server dependencies, local database, market service binary, client path, client certificate CA
Fixed the mod marketplace manifest failing to load in the 0.12.9 environment (dual sources: EVEjs-mods Pages and jsDelivr)
Mod publishing now uses local signing plus a GitHub token; the author identity key and token are imported from the old launcher automatically - nothing to re-enter
Much smaller: the portable executable is about 9.2 MB versus about 73 MB for the current Electron portable build (gate: exe <= 12 MB)

Fixed the service card readings: the image service and gateway proxy have no standalone process, so their stats used to be a permanent dash; they now follow the main server's PID / CPU / memory / uptime. Their run state still comes from their own port probes and will not turn green just because the main server is running

Fixed new mods still landing as loader.js.disabled even with Enable right after creation ticked: the UI sent internal key names (enableAfterCreate / signAfterCreate) while the backend reads enabled / sign, so the checkbox did nothing. Ticking it now produces a loadable loader.js, and new mods are enabled by default

Fixed mods that had been published once no longer being selectable in Submit mod: the old filter dropped anything in review, but publishing now just pushes a new version to your own repo and cuts a Release, while the source index is registered only once, so no review state should block a new version. The candidate list now filters only by ownership, and a local .evejs-source.json also counts as proof of an existing source repo so a changed data dir no longer causes a duplicate repo creation

Edit info now actually saves: a new mods:updateMeta channel rewrites only the display name / description / category / tags / conflicts / restart semantics and the README (id, version, author and signature are never touched), re-signs after writing, rolls the whole change back if signing fails, and refuses mods owned by someone else

New single-file portable build: double-click one EvEJSLauncher.exe of about 9.2 MB - no unzip, no installer. The launcher cache (data / cache / cli / updater / mods / temp) still lives in the _launcher folder next to the exe, and the bundled Node CLIs and self-updater are released on first launch (skipped when identical, and corrupted files are repaired automatically)

Fixed the fake Import ZIP button in the mod market: it only popped a canned 'mod package selected...' toast without opening a file dialog or writing anything. It now really opens the system ZIP picker, rescans the mod list afterwards and reports where the package landed (cancelling stays silent, and a package missing from the market index gets its own warning). The neighbouring Open mods folder button now performs the real action too, creating the folder first when missing

Fixed the mods page claiming the server root was wrong on a fully deployed server: the renderer additionally compared the configured path against a hard-coded old directory (E:\Games\EveJS-v0.12.8), so anything else - such as 0.12.9 - was always reported as invalid. It now trusts only the backend scanner verdict, and the banner says what it actually means: the folder has no mods/ directory, with a one-click Create mods/ button instead of sending users off to find the directory themselves

The self-update dialog now reads the real release notes from the update manifest (its changelog field) instead of showing the prototype's sample entries; grouping and styling follow the prototype, and both Chinese and English notes render

Fixed the submit-for-review completion message being wrong: a first-time publish really does open a source-registration PR, but it reported 'no PR' because the ledger was reloaded before the check; the real outcome and the PR link are now shown
